purpose: Create the Owner-authorised real purchase as an ADDITIONAL staging vehicle/transaction. Every value below is either observed on the Owner's own BE FORWARD CAP page, a schema-mandatory placeholder that follows an existing CarUp convention, or deliberately absent. Nothing is inferred. A column not listed here is left to its schema default.

source.system: BE FORWARD CAP (customer portal page for the Owner's own purchase)
source.method: Owner-authorised REA capture of the rendered page; the access token is a secret and appears nowhere in this repository
source.evidence: private bundle held outside the repository (cap-00 evidence bundle, scenario cap-scn-01-initial-load); not committed

account.note: The canonical staging account. Its display name is NOT changed from the CAP spelling of the consignee.

protected_vehicle.note: The existing 2016 Nissan Serena Highway Star. A different legitimate vehicle: it is fingerprinted before and after, and the run is rolled back if it differs by one byte.

vin.note: CAP exposes a chassis number and no separate VIN. CarUp's own Japan-import identity convention uses the chassis as the vehicle key (docs/DIASPORA_TRADE_OS_MVP_ACCEPTANCE_MATRIX.md row 24 'chassis-as-vin'; docs/CARUP_REAL_LISTING_ELIGIBILITY_CONTRACT.md: documented import frame/chassis identifiers are valid, CarUp never fabricates a 17-character VIN for an import). The existing Serena is keyed the same way. At 11 characters it is below the marketplace-listing floor of 12 — it is NOT a marketplace listing and is not published.

trim.note: CAP grade; model code DAA-RU3 has no column and is not stored

mileage.note: as stated by BE FORWARD at purchase; not an attested odometer reading

price.note: vehicles.price is NOT NULL. 0 is the existing 'not listed for sale' convention (insertVehicleIdentity). It is NOT the purchase price, which is unknown to CarUp and is not recorded.

destination_country.note: NOT NULL with default 'Zimbabwe'. Consistent with the CAP consignee country (Zimbabwe), but CAP's own 'Destination' field is blank — this is the order's country, not a claim that anything has reached it. The Dar es Salaam port of discharge is a separate fact on the shipment.

status.note: the earliest status. Nothing later is claimed: no documents verified, no container booked, no loading, no sailing.

origin_port.note: CAP port of loading: SHIMONOSEKI / JAPAN

destination_port.note: CAP port of discharge: DAR ES SALAAM. A port of discharge is not the destination.

estimated_arrival_date.note: CAP ETA 18-Sep-2026, date only. It is an ESTIMATE and is already in the past; no arrival has been observed.

planned_departure_date.note: CAP ETD 29-Aug-2026, date only. A PLAN: CAP shows a 'Load Confirmed' marker but no time, and CarUp has no observation of a departure.

planned_departure_source.note: what createShipment writes for a date supplied at creation

left_unset: NO IN_TRANSIT / ARRIVED / RELEASED / COMPLETED event or date: CAP's per-stage times are not established

leg_sequence.note: CAP shows a single vessel and a single leg; no transshipment is recorded

vessel_name.note: verbatim, including the parenthesised V-61 which CAP does not label. It is NOT interpreted as a voyage number.

source_reference.value: BE FORWARD CAP customer page, observed 2026-10-24 (Owner-authorised capture). Vessel name as displayed.

not_recorded: any shipping document (B/L, invoice, export certificate)
the consignee's name, phone and street address
